title: Nothing like ordering directly from KitNipBox
text: I’ve purchased multiple boxes directly from KitNipBox and always pleased, however this has not been the case with purchasing now on two occasions via Amazon.  The boxes appear to be quite a bit smaller (less quantity) and lower quality (less quantity) of items.  The toys and packaging that come via Amazon don’t appear to have any catnip.  My cats go crazy over the boxes that are ordered directly from KitNipBox, and respond lackluster with these Amazon boxes.
label: neutral
